explicitlyRegisteredDirectory.observedEffect: registered.pdf was created under the registered directory; its new path appeared in inputAfterSha256 and changed the run to INPUT_CHANGED_REVIEW_REQUIRED

unregisteredParameterPath.observedEffect: file.exportPdf created a PDF outside --output and outside every --input path; the path is absent from inputAfterSha256

scopeConclusion.protected: The gateway rejects a pre-existing --output directory, copies --source, and hashes --source/--input files or directories before and after native execution. A change under an explicitly registered input is detected after execution and downgrades a zero-exit receipt; this is detection, not write prevention.
scopeConclusion.unprotected: Paths embedded in native command params are not automatically constrained to --output, sandboxed, or hashed. New sibling output paths outside --source/--input remain untracked. Native commands can write anywhere allowed by the current OS account.
